name: Pair probe
note: Method inner loop. One pair of misfit variables arrives as [idA, textA, idB, textB]; a decide cell judges whether they interact and with what sign. Alexander's correlation step, made honest: every interaction claim is a typed decision with a receipt, not an intuition. The output is always a record — {linked:false} when the pair is independent — so the collector can filter on structure.

cells.prompt: Two misfit variables from one design ensemble, as [id, statement, id, statement]. Judge their interaction.

interact.instructions: Does satisfying or failing one misfit change the other's prospects? 1 = tightly coupled, 0 = independent.

sign.instructions: If they interact: does satisfying one help the other (concord) or hinder it (conflict)?
